read_sections: §1.1-1.3, pp.1-8: smooth/polygonal knots, diagrams, Reidemeister theorem, crossing number and colorings
§2.1-2.2, pp.9-20: unknot/disk characterization, Jordan curve theorem, compact oriented surface classification

limitations: The notes explicitly say the smooth/polygonal equivalence paragraph in §1.1 is not rigorously proved.
Regular projection, diagram determination, and Reidemeister's theorem are exercises (Exercises 1.3, 1.4 and 1.6).
The Seifert algorithm is geometric and does not fully formalize disjoint placement of nested disks, band embeddings or orientation checks.
The genus-additivity proof invokes transversality and compression/cut-and-paste without proving every preparation.

sources.citation: Hoel Queffelec, Reidemeister's theorem using transversality, arXiv:2406.18203v1, 26 June 2024; later appeared in Bulletin of the Australian Mathematical Society.
read_sections: Multijet transversality setup and Theorem 2, pp.3-5
limitations: The theorem is stated for knots, not finite oriented links.
Mather/Golubitsky-Guillemin multijet transversality is stated and cited, not proved.
§3.3 works out the R1 cusp; §§3.4-3.5 only sketch R3 and R2 and explicitly call parts handwaving/a few equations.
It does not supply the repository's oriented variants or ambient-isotopy conventions. It is a source roadmap, not the complete local proof.

sources.citation: Mohamed Elhamdadi, Mustafa Hajij, and Kyle Istvan, Framed Knots, arXiv:1910.10257v6, 23 May 2020.
read_sections: §§1-2, pp.1-3: smooth link, framed knot/ribbon, ambient equivalence
§3-3.1, pp.3-9: signs, linking, intersection, self-linking, blackboard framing, writhe, framed Reidemeister sketch
§4-4.3, pp.10-15: torus curves, meridian/longitude, relation to framing
§5-6, pp.15-17: Seifert zero framing and SO(2) integer description
§7-7.1, pp.17-20 and references, pp.20-21: surgery context
limitations: The introduction says some equivalences are intuitively justified and details are cited when outside scope.
Crossing signs are supplied mainly by a right-hand-rule figure, not an algebraic tangent determinant convention.
Its opening knot definition says smooth one-to-one map but omits immersion; the repository's embedding definition is sharper.
The blackboard-writhe and framed-Reidemeister arguments are diagrammatic; the kink-pairing step needs a fuller proof if made a theorem.
The SO(2) framing classification is an explanatory sketch, not a formal proof of the framing-class bijection.
The surgery theorem is cited, not proved, and is outside this lane.

limitations: The index says the notes are based on Livingston's Carus monograph and warns that the course notes are untested and may contain typographical errors.
Section 2.3 defines polygonal elementary deformations, not equivalence with the repository's smooth ambient-isotopy model.
Section 2.4 Theorem 2.4.1/2.4.2 proofs are assigned exercises; Theorem 2.4.3 has a partial argument and is assigned an exercise.
Section 3.1 states Reidemeister's theorem but calls the proof informal and delegates a rigorous proof to Burde-Zieschang, pp.9-10.
Section 4.3 Theorem 4.3.7's supplement builds disks and twisted bands but leaves orientability to Exercise 4.3.3; the proof is a picture-driven sketch.
Section 4.5 treats connected sum picture-wise and sketches genus additivity by innermost-circle surgery; it expressly says the prime-decomposition uniqueness part is not proved.

local_suppliers.reusable_interface: Finite disjoint union of smoothly embedded oriented circles in S^3; equivalence by orientation-preserving ambient isotopy and source reparametrization.
local_suppliers.boundary: Smooth model only; explicitly says no polygonal model is used.

local_suppliers.reusable_interface: Fixed projection R^3 to R^2; immersive projection, finitely many transverse double points, no triple points; over/under data and strand orientations.
local_suppliers.boundary: No algebraic positive/negative crossing sign is defined.

local_suppliers.reusable_interface: Orientation-preserving smooth ambient isotopy of R^2 transporting decorated diagrams.
R1, R2 and R3 with all orientation/sign variants, strict height-order convention for R3, and braid-like variants.
local_suppliers.boundary: Sign labels are used but a preceding sign definition is absent.

local_suppliers.reusable_interface: Under AC_omega, regular projection directions are dense; each has finitely many double points.
Relative-end perturbation of a compact smooth link isotopy with finite cusp, tangency and triple events; AC_omega/transversality dependencies explicit.
Classifies cusp as R1, quadratic tangency as R2, triple event as R3, and regular intervals as planar isotopy.
Explicit local embedded families for each oriented move and compactly supported ambient extension.
Under AC_omega, equivalent smooth oriented links have diagrams related by planar isotopies and finitely many oriented R1-R3 moves.
local_suppliers.boundary: Only the smooth oriented link model in S^3; no PL comparison theorem.

local_suppliers.reusable_interface: Unique orientation-compatible smoothing; finite Seifert circles and one signed arc for each original crossing.
Pairwise coherence via the common annulus; height counts incoherent pairs.
local_suppliers.boundary: Uses the annulus existence supplier and AC; height is not Seifert genus.

local_suppliers.reusable_interface: Defect region, reducing arc and local R2 replacement.
Each reducing move lowers diagram height by exactly one; finite termination.
Height-zero diagrams are isotopic to closed-braid form with an explicit Artin word.
Every oriented smooth link in R^3 is equivalent to a closed braid; Yamada-Vogel height reduction terminates.
Framed oriented tangle category, fixed boundary collars, framed isotopy and blackboard-framed generators.
local_suppliers.boundary: No classical knot self-linking integer, zero framing or link-diagram framing theorem.

local_suppliers.reusable_interface: A framing is an actual trivialization of an embedded submanifold's normal bundle.
Artin exponent-sum homomorphism, conjugacy invariance and +/-1 shift under stabilization.
local_suppliers.boundary: Braid word invariant only; it is not a link-diagram crossing-sign or writhe definition.

local_suppliers.reusable_interface: AC_omega compact smooth isotopy extension with prescribed support and stationary endpoint collars.
Classification of closed compact connected surfaces and orientable genus/Euler characteristic.

local_suppliers.inspected: Complete statement; full proof checked through the boundary-genus interface.
local_suppliers.reusable_interface: For compact connected C2 surfaces with b>0 boundary circles, capping defines genus g and chi=2-2g-b.
Closures of sigma_1^m are T(2,m); component counts and small m=0,+/-1,+/-3 cases.
Full Yamada-Vogel run on 5_2 with explicit braid word and reductions.

local_suppliers.inspected: Complete definition body. Positive Artin half twist is explicit anticlockwise transverse-disk motion; the left indexed point passes below its midpoint. This is the calibration supplier for any link-diagram crossing sign.
Complete definition body. Uses a fixed axis/framing map, cycles of the endpoint permutation, oriented closure and page intersections.
Complete definition body. Defines conjugation and signed stabilization/destabilization with a fixed right-side Artin convention.
Complete statement, facts and proof. Gives actual ambient closure isotopies; stabilization is identified with a signed R1 kink.
Complete theorem statement and proof. Markov classification consumes the local oriented Reidemeister supplier; no need to duplicate this braid theorem in reader-1 scope.
Complete example and proof for both stabilization signs.
Complete counterexample. Strand number is preserved by conjugacy; stabilization is necessary.

missing_local_modules.contract: Finite polygonal embeddings of a finite disjoint union of circles in the standard PL 3-sphere; define tame knot/link as ambient-isotopic to such a model and exclude wild embeddings.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Definition only; do not conflate arbitrary continuous injective maps with smooth embeddings.

missing_local_modules.contract: Every compact smooth link has a polygonal representative, every polygonal link rounds to a smooth representative, and both ambient-isotopy equivalence relations classify the same tame link types.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Use compact tubular collars; round vertices in disjoint balls; approximate a smooth component by a sufficiently fine polygonal normal graph; interpolate through embeddings relative to isotopy end collars; state category and dimension hypotheses.

missing_local_modules.contract: With the oriented projection plane fixed, define crossing sign from ordered tangents of over- and under-branches, calibrate positive Artin generator as +1, and define writhe and half-sum mixed-crossing linking number.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Coordinate check the sign convention, verify invariance under orientation-preserving planar isotopy, and state mirror/component-reversal behavior.

missing_local_modules.contract: For disjoint oriented components, the half-sum of mixed crossing signs is an integer invariant, symmetric in components, changes sign when one component reverses, and equals signed intersection with an oriented spanning surface for the other component.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Check R1/R2/R3 locally; then use relative homology/Alexander duality or an explicit crossing-change/additivity argument for intersection equality.

missing_local_modules.contract: Define oriented connected sum using disjoint balls/short arcs and an orientation-compatible band; state whether component labels are ignored; define mirror and orientation reversal separately.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Well-definedness under choices is a separate result unless the definition fixes a standard local model.

missing_local_modules.contract: Define c(D), c(K)=minimum over diagrams in the fixed Reidemeister class, Seifert surface for a knot, and minimal genus; distinguish diagram crossing count from knot invariant.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Use Seifert-surface existence to make genus a minimum over a nonempty subset of nonnegative integers; do not claim a general minimization algorithm.

missing_local_modules.contract: Input a finite regular oriented link diagram; smooth crossings, place nested spanning disks, attach one signed half-twisted band per crossing; output a finite orientable surface with the original link as boundary.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Separate procedure from correctness. Use Jordan-Schoenflies for disks, disjoint crossing balls, nesting order and local band/orientation checks; termination follows from finitely many crossings.

missing_local_modules.contract: For s Seifert circles, c crossings and m link components, the algorithm yields chi=s-c; for a knot its connected surface gives the canonical genus bound.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Verify local band restoration and embeddedness; count chi from s disks and c one-handles; apply the compact-boundary surface genus formula.

missing_local_modules.contract: Define a framed smooth link as a link with a homotopy class of nonvanishing normal sections and a specified framed-isotopy equivalence; distinguish this from a stable framing.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Use the local normal-bundle and framed-tangle definitions; explain how an oriented normal 2-plane plus a nonzero section determines a full frame.

missing_local_modules.contract: Relative framings of a fixed oriented knot form a Z-torsor; Seifert framing has self-linking zero; blackboard framing self-linking equals diagram writhe; a single kink changes blackboard framing by +/-1.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Use pi_1(SO(2))=Z relative to a reference framing; identify self-linking by a normal pushoff; count local mixed crossings; prove Seifert framing has zero intersection with its spanning surface.

missing_local_modules.contract: Characterize framed-isotopy equivalence of framed link diagrams using R2/R3 and a precisely drawn modified R1 move or equivalent framed move set.
missing_local_modules.proof_route: Track framing integer through ordinary Reidemeister moves; prove the paired-kink slide/modified move suffices when the net framing change is zero.

reuse_first: Existing smooth link and oriented Reidemeister items as prerequisites; do not duplicate them in the new category.
Existing Seifert smoothing, Yamada-Vogel height reduction and Alexander closed-braid theorem.
Existing framed-tangle and normal-bundle framing definitions.
Existing compact-surface classification and boundary Euler/genus supplier.
new_pair_order: Tame PL and smooth link models with an explicit equivalence bridge.
Oriented diagram sign, writhe, linking number and crossing number.
Connected sum, mirror/reversal and certified elementary examples.
Seifert surfaces, algorithm, correctness and diagram Euler/genus bound.
Minimal genus and additivity only if a complete innermost-circle/cut-and-paste proof is assigned.
Framed knots, framing integer, self-linking, Seifert/blackboard framing and framed Reidemeister equivalence.
caveats: A finite knot table is a list of representatives only after duplicate/classification proofs; a picture count alone is not a minimality certificate.
The local Reidemeister theorem is smooth and oriented; any PL consumer needs the equivalence bridge.
The local braid writhe is exponent sum, not a general link-diagram writhe.
